name: Herbalist
summary: A Universal World Class any character may take regardless of their class. It levels through active use (foraging, harvesting and every step at the bench), opening new methods and rarer material at levels 1 to 3. Past level 3 the levels never stop, and each one grants two perks: potency, duration, quality or yield.
_ruling_2026_10_02_note: The owner's herbalism revamp ruling, 2026-10-02 (docs/herbalism-revamp-plan.md §2, §4, §14). Three unlock levels replace five: level 1 grind, mix and brew on common and uncommon material; level 2 dry, reduce, extract, infuse and steep on rare and exotic; level 3 neutralize and legendary material. Distill, preserve, purify, refine and catalyst crafting are removed, with the old level 4 and 5 rows, the `legendary-catalyst` milestone and its deed. The Alchemist already has its own verbs (calcine through catalyze), so nothing moved across. Old saves keep their level: an old Herbalist 4 or 5 is an endless level 4 or 5 with its perk picks banked (rules/worldclass.py `migrate_herbalist`).
_thresholds_note: Mastery to reach levels 2 and 3; every level after that is priced by `endless`. 25 and 65 are the numbers the five-level track settled on (the author's table read 10/25, raised because 10 and 25 did not reach the author's own pacing targets), kept unchanged by the 2026-10-02 ruling. The awards behind them changed: the bench now pays each step on its own (1, +1 per rarity band above common, +1 at Superior, +2 at Flawless or higher) and firsts pay 3, so a level-1 step on common material is worth 1 and a first herb or product type 3 more. The pacing under the step awards has not yet been measured in play.
_endless_note: Levels past the written table, plan §4.2, owner-accepted 2026-10-02. Leaving level 3 costs `base` and each level after it `step` more (50, 60, 70...), gentle on purpose because the perks are small. Each endless level banks `picks_per_level` picks; the same perk may be taken twice. `perks` is what one pick of each is worth: potency and duration add to their multipliers, quality raises the ceiling by that many steps, yield is the chance per craft of one extra dose. All proposed numbers, tunable here without a code change.
_ceiling_note: `ceiling` is the highest quality index a level's hands can reach (0 Crude, 1 Sound, 2 Fine, 3 Superior, 4 Flawless), plan §4.3. Each Quality perk adds one past Flawless: Flawless +1, +2 and so on.

levels.note: Infusions, decoctions, poultices and salve bases.
Dried herbs, reductions, infused oils, salves, balms and creams, tinctures and acetums, and field harvesting of monster parts.
Volatile material made safe, and legendary material.

method_descriptions.grind: Crushes a solid into powder. Bark, sap and resin grind into salve base.
method_descriptions.mix: Combines two or more prepared things: a fresh poultice with a binder, a salve base blend, or a salve, balm or cream from a base and an infused oil.
method_descriptions.brew: Boils a herb in water. Leaf and flower make an infusion; root, bark and berry make a stronger, slower decoction.
method_descriptions.dry: Dries two of a solid into one, half again as potent and half again as long lasting. What has been dried can be dried again.
method_descriptions.reduce: Simmers two doses of a liquid down to one, half again as potent and half again as long lasting.
method_descriptions.extract: Takes the usable part out of a shell, gland or pod without spoiling it. A clumsy cut costs potency.
method_descriptions.infuse: Steeps a dried herb in oil, one oil per dose, to make an infused oil for salves, balms and creams, or for sale.
method_descriptions.steep: Seals a herb in alcohol or vinegar. The jar is ready in two weeks as a tincture, or one week as an acetum.
method_descriptions.neutralize: Makes a volatile ingredient safe to work, at the cost of one neutralizer per dose and a little of its strength.

_fixed_tools_note: Emptied 2026-10-02. The alchemical still left with distill and the master herbalist workbench with level 5. The revamped bench is a fold-out forager's kit that goes wherever the character stands (plan §2, 'Mood'), so the Herbalist has no installation. The 2026-08-25 ruling still holds for the tracks that declare fixed tools: they stay unread until property ownership exists.
